purpose: Pre-run author-created contrast tasks. Not independent, standardized, or representative accuracy evidence. Queries are frozen before this experiment runs; labels never enter scoring.

cases.en: Implement a GPU attention kernel using Triton with online softmax. Explain causal masking and grouped-query attention variants, then check numerical correctness against a reference.
cases.zh: 用Triton实现GPU注意力算子，采用在线Softmax，说明因果掩码和分组查询变体，并对照参考实现核对数值正确性。

cases.en: For a stiff differential-equation simulation, choose an implicit time stepping scheme, configure local error tolerances and adaptive steps, and compare stability. This is not about merging software branches.
cases.zh: 针对刚性微分方程仿真选择隐式时间推进方法，配置局部误差容限和自适应步长，比较稳定性；不是软件分支合并。

cases.en: Investigate a disputed technology claim through independent searches, fetch primary sources, challenge the evidence and write a cited synthesis. Do not alter accessibility attributes in an interface.
cases.zh: 通过多路独立检索调查一项有争议的技术结论，读取原始来源、反向核验证据，形成带引用的综合报告；不修改界面无障碍属性。

cases.en: Audit this MultiversX smart contract against its specification and MIP requirements, focusing on tokenomics deviations. Do not produce a general literature review.
cases.zh: 对照规格和MIP要求审计这个MultiversX智能合约，重点核对代币经济实现偏差；不是写一般性文献综述。

cases.en: Tune an HNSW vector index under a memory limit. Compare search latency and recall while changing graph connectivity, construction effort and query effort. Do not redesign the application splash screen.
cases.zh: 在内存限制下调优HNSW向量索引，分别调整图连接数、构建开销与查询开销，比较召回和检索延迟；不重新设计应用启动画面。

cases.en: For a Django REST endpoint, first write a failing pytest-django test, create fixtures with factory_boy and mock the remote dependency, then implement the behavior. No GPU kernel work is needed.
cases.zh: 为Django REST接口先写失败的pytest-django测试，用factory_boy创建数据并模拟远端依赖，再实现行为；不需要GPU算子开发。

cases.en: Take a password-reset feature from requirements to delivery: decompose test-first tasks for focused implementers, review specification compliance separately from code quality, then integrate the finished changes.
cases.zh: 把密码重置功能从需求推进到交付：拆分先写测试的任务交给专注的实现者，分别评审规格符合性与代码质量，最后集成完成的变更。

cases.en: A burst of requests causes timeouts. Establish a baseline, separate CPU saturation from database queueing, run staggered arrivals, then compare throughput and tail latency after tuning. Keep the interface unchanged.
cases.zh: 请求突发时出现超时。建立基线，区分CPU饱和与数据库排队，测试错峰到达，再比较调优后的吞吐量和尾延迟；界面保持不变。

cases.en: Prepare a battery-technology landscape report with independent parallel investigators, another role checking citations and contradictory evidence, and an editor combining the reviewed findings into a final report.
cases.zh: 编写电池技术路线报告，让独立调查者并行查资料，另一角色核实引用和矛盾证据，再由编辑把审阅后的发现汇总成最终报告。

cases.en: Design the architecture of a booking platform through coordinated business, security, system and deployment specialists. Require artifact handoffs and a final consistency check across their outputs.
cases.zh: 组织业务、安全、系统和部署专家共同设计预约平台的架构，各角色交接完整产物，最后检查跨产物一致性。

cases.en: An upgraded dependency removed a method. Find current-version official documentation and usage examples for the replacement before proposing a code change; do not use obsolete snippets.
cases.zh: 依赖升级后移除了一个方法。先查询当前版本官方文档和替代接口用例，再提出代码修改建议；不要引用过期片段。

cases.en: Discover a legal connector for statute and similar-case retrieval concerning a contract disagreement. Only inspect available capabilities; do not upload documents or assume access is free.
cases.zh: 寻找能检索合同争议相关法规和类似判例的法律连接器，仅检查可用能力，不上传文档，也不要假设服务免费。

limitations: Authored using known failure mechanisms and source descriptions; not a blind benchmark.
Negative clauses deliberately stress exclusion handling. Mentioning a forbidden capability is not an instruction to use it.
Labels are partial identity proxies; equivalent workflows need semantic review.
No business module, external connector, paid API, or task execution is authorized by this dataset.
